name: Raw series baseline
purpose: Keep timestamped observations in a direct raw-series representation so every temporal workload has a simple baseline candidate.

name: Time-bucketed raw series
purpose: Partition raw observations by series identity and a time bucket for bounded time-range scans.

name: Co-located multi-metric series
purpose: Keep multiple metrics for the same series/time axis together when the workload reads them jointly.

name: Metric-specific / alternate-access projection
purpose: Create a temporal projection oriented to one metric or an alternate dimension when the query is not anchored by the canonical series identity.

name: Latest-state snapshot
purpose: Maintain the most recent state separately when the workload repeatedly asks for the newest observation rather than a history range.

name: Rollup / multi-resolution aggregate
purpose: Materialize time-bucketed summaries such as hourly or daily aggregates.

name: Dimension/group aggregate
purpose: Materialize temporal aggregates additionally grouped by a non-time dimension such as category, region, tenant, or device type.

name: Tag / dimension discovery
purpose: Support discovery of series identities through tags/dimensions without first knowing the series key.

name: Model-segment representation
purpose: Represent a time series as fitted/model segments when the logical workload explicitly requests piecewise/trend segments rather than raw samples.
